items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: The name 'Justin' appears only in the interviewer's question ('Did Bunk ever work any little jobs like that, Justin?') and is not mentioned or responded to by the interviewee in a way that establishes a personal relationship.

ctx.x: Well, just in the later years, those big bands started coming in. Come through there? Yeah, but most of the time they used little bands out on the wall, like Papa Celestine used to come in. Come out of New Iberia. Yeah, he used to come in and play in. New Barbering band. He was from New, somewhere around here. They used to come out there. But this later years, a big band started going out there.

Was there much, of course, I know you didn't get around to all the bar rooms, but I mean, do you think there were many bands working there, like on Saturday nights every week in some of the small places, maybe two or three musicians? Did Bunk ever work any little jobs like that, Justin?

Well, that's what, yeah, that's what I told him and his Uncle Henry used to work little jobs like that. And Bird Guard Adams as well. And this was, I think it was just four of them. I can't remember, the other one's name was Minor. I don't know, I forgot his name. But he died. But he was playing banjo. And they used to work little jobs like that on Saturday night at a, let me see what this was, a place of man was. They used to work there every Saturday night, this man named, I forgot his name.
